scope: Exact source-pixel next-one/two-frame forecast on one recording; not physical 3D, calibrated uncertainty or live accuracy
future_support_warning: The detector can use two future source frames, including the evaluated targets; fit supports are past-only but this is NOT a causal forecast benchmark.
reference_policy: Zero-based official CSV matched to exact one-based native source frames; no interpolation; absent references are not assigned a location
baseline_policy: Paired same eligible references/targets; last-position and constant-velocity use the last one/two raw observed fit-support centers; no GT gating
fit_input_policy: Default detector-only journal; filtered experimental-tracker inputs are rejected until they have explicit fitting-observation provenance

contacts.note: Only native contact/motion segment boundaries influence existing fits; no GT-based resets or contact exclusions

metadata_policy: Malformed metadata or incomplete source coverage aborts evaluation; not omitted as abstentions
